content: This invariably includes a valid Tax Clearance Certificate from the South African Revenue Service (SARS) and a Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment (B-BBEE) certificate. A higher B-BBEE contributor level provides a significant competitive advantage. Additionally, registration on the National Treasury's Central Supplier Database (CSD) is mandatory for all public sector work.
